entities.summary: The demolition or burning of Masjid al-Dirar , or the Mosque of Dissent, is mentioned in the Qur'an. The Masjid al-Dirar was a mosque in Medina that was erected close to the Quba Mosque and which Muhammad initially approved of, but subsequently destroyed while returning from the Expedition to Tabuk, which occurred in October 630.)
